remainingEvidence: §5.2.1 now closes every named spec gap by composition: 'the operator' is defined as the authenticated Principal invoking the administer-impact merge-resolution Operation — there was never a second resolution path, just one mechanism the prose named twice; policies.treeMerge is specified as one more field of PolicySet (§9.2) alongside tiers/approvals/placement, not a new artifact; and the SPEC's TreeMergeResolution type now carries the base/environment fields the implementation already has, closing that mismatch

PolicySet (src/definition/policy.ts) still has no treeMerge field — a closed-key codec-major-3 change to one existing W4 record, now scoped precisely — and commit.ts's environment field is a bare string rather than EnvironmentId, a small typing fix bundled with whatever implementation lands the field

Conflict detection itself remains entirely unimplemented: no per-path tree model exists over the single opaque tree checkpoint digest, so 'paths changed on both sides' cannot be computed and no unresolved-conflict state blocks a merge commit. This is the substantial remaining piece — a real diff engine over ContentStore-addressed trees — genuine W5 implementation scope, not a spec ambiguity

remainingEvidence: SpawnReservation exists as a record, but no executor path returns an admission identity in the model's tool position, so the permission this atom grants has no implementation to cite

The testable prohibition — a spawn's `delegate` Receipt carries the child RunRef and never the child's result — needs a negative test on Receipt content; no current test inspects what a `delegate` Receipt carries

The lease-fenced half exists — InboxProtocol rejects delivery without the exact current Turn lease — but no reserved `turn.cancel` Event kind exists anywhere in src, so the cancellation contract is unimplemented

The executor obligation has no seam to test against: nothing observes a cancellation signal between Turn steps or stops committing on it, so both the delivery-on-fence and the stop-committing halves are outstanding
